newsitem.title: USA: Abigail Adams National to buy Ballston unit.
newsitem.headline: Abigail Adams National to buy Ballston unit.

text.p: Abigail Adams National Bancorp Inc said on Wednesday that it had signed a letter of intent to acquire the stock of privately held Ballston Bancorp Inc for roughly $14 million in cash and Abigail common stock.

The proposed acquisition, which would be accounted for as a purchase, would be realized through a merger of the business of Ballston's subsidiary, the Bank of Northern Virginia, Abigail Adams said in a statement.
Abigail Adams also said it expected to close the transaction no later than December 31, pending shareholder approval and other conditions.
